decision_priority: `beacon-implement` remains the only public implementation skill.
Mode playbooks explain execution shape; they do not create public lifecycle stages.
Help/status recommendations must include the reason and canonical command.
Ralph routes next action and evidence; it does not replace QA, release, gate, or frozen truth.
Skill Eval Kit must preserve route stability and reject nonexistent public mode-specific skills.
Ralph Task Loop checkpoint/recovery and learn lifecycle injection remain separate backlog features.
